Initial release of html-designer-tool-free – a professional HTML/CSS visual design assistant for individual developers.

- Provides visual hierarchy, typography, color scheme generation, and layout design based on established design principles.
- Outputs clean HTML5 structures with semantic tags and CSS following BEM naming conventions.
- Supports responsive and accessible web design (e.g., ARIA labels, skip links, viewport meta tags).
- Includes three preset color schemes, basic templates, and sample components optimized for personal portfolios, landing pages, and marketing pages.
- Enables fast prototyping through natural language commands and configuration examples.
- Free version is limited to basic templates, three color schemes, and core web components without batch generation or advanced customization.
